neighbours.label: The token ' fur', strongest where it opens a compound or a longer word (fur collar, fur trade, fur|rowed), vs other material or texture words in the same frames
fire: On the coldest days my grandfather wore a fur hat with ear flaps.
The trappers sold their pelts to a fur trader in Montreal.
Her brow furrowed as she read the letter again.
The actress arrived in a long fur coat and dark glasses.
On the rocks below, a fur seal was sleeping in the sun.
The plough left a straight furrow across the wet field.
Animal rights groups protested outside the fur shop downtown.
He hung his fur cap on the hook by the door.
